The '''Kyromaster ion engine''' was an [[Ion engine/Legends|ion engine]] which was manufactured by [[Quadex/Legends|Quadex]]. The engine was used on [[Slayn & Korpil/Legends|Slayn & Korpil's]] [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter]], with the thrust directed through four [[splitter plate]]s. Alternate configurations of the B-wing replaced the Kyromaster with four [[JZ-5 Fusial Thrust Engine]]s. A scaled down version of the Kyromaster was used in [[Bespin Motors/Legends|Bespin Motors']] [[Storm IV Twin-Pod cloud car/Legends|Storm IV Twin-Pod cloud car]], mounted on the connecting boom and open to the air so it could be cooled effectively.<ref name="EGVV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>
